comment: Layer-specific oelint-adv constant DB. oelint-adv auto-loads 'oelint.constants.json' from the layer root (the directory holding conf/layer.conf) whenever a file from this layer is linted (given as a ./ or absolute path), so no --constantmods is needed. '$imports' pulls in the constants oelint-data ships for layers this one depends on (e.g. openembedded-layer, freescale-layer; core is implied): fill it from LAYERDEPENDS first. List here the real variables/overrides oelint cannot know about when run standalone (outside a full bitbake build): custom global variables the layer defines, and distro/machine override tokens the recipes use. Start empty and add entries only when the baseline survey shows false 'unknown variable/override' findings.
